items.content_html: EnterpriseGuard WAF is a lightweight enterprise web application firewall that protects web apps and APIs from SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, brute-force attacks, and suspicious traffic. It uses rule-based filtering, anomaly scoring, rate limiting, logging, and an admin dashboard to detect, block, and monitor threats in real time.
